productConcept.name: Roundwork Studio
productConcept.description: Hand-pressed kitchen tools and home objects made in Oaxaca. Every piece designed without sharp edges — thrown, pressed, or carved into rounded plump forms.
productConcept.rationale: Claymorphism aesthetic (inflated geometry, spring physics, rounded forms, tactile shadows) maps directly to a ceramics/handcraft studio. The burnt orange accent and forest green hero palette match earthen kiln and material tones. Figtree's circular letterforms echo the rounded stoneware forms.
